verdict.rationale: CloudConvert's own job model chains multiple tasks (import, convert, export) in one job, and the Socket API gives real-time per-task updates, which suggests per-item results within a run. However, no evidence explicitly shows converting a whole folder or list of many files in one job. Merging files into one PDF and creating archives are adjacent features, and Zapier workflows are external tooling, so none of them count toward batch conversion. missing for 10: explicit documentation of multi-file or folder batch conversion in a single job, documented per-file result or status reporting for batches, hands-on or independent corroboration.
